content.stem: 当金融机构收到有关客户的联邦大陪审团传票时,应采取何种行动？

options.A: 复印客户的文件,并将原件提交给执法机构
options.B: 在提交文件前通知被调查的客户
options.C: 应执法机构的口头请求,保持客户账户的开放状态
options.D: 请该机构指派的法律顾问审查传票

content.stem_en: Which action should a financial institution take when it receives a grand-jury subpoena regarding a customer?

options_en.A: Make copies of the customer's documents and submit the originals to the enforcement agency
options_en.B: Notify the customer being investigated before submitting documents
options_en.C: Keep the customer's accounts open at the enforcement agency's verbal request
options_en.D: Have the institution's assigned legal counsel review the subpoena
